profile.name: M S AJAYNATH
profile.heroDescription: I build scalable applications, AI-powered platforms, full-stack web systems, and databases. Passionate about turning complex academic and personal challenges into reliable software.

paragraphs: I'm AJAYNATH M S, a motivated MCA student with strong knowledge in Full Stack Development, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Database Management. I enjoy building Al-driven and web-based applications, solving real-world problems, and growing in collaborative environments.

My experience includes developing an AI-powered mock test platform ("Level-Up") utilizing React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and OpenRouter API, as well as leading a team-based Machine Learning project for Fake News Detection. I am proficient in Python, Java, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.

Whether it's training machine learning models, crafting clean user interfaces, or designing backend APIs, I believe great software comes from continuous learning, curiosity, and a genuine care for engineering quality.

projectsDescription: A collection of full-stack, AI, IoT, and machine learning projects focused on solving practical problems through modern technologies. These projects demonstrate my experience in developing end-to-end applications, integrating AI capabilities, building responsive user interfaces, designing backend APIs, and applying machine learning to real-world use cases.

projects.title: Smart Automatic Attendance System(working on it)
projects.description: An Android-based smart attendance system that automatically marks student attendance using an ESP8266 classroom Wi-Fi beacon. Teachers start an attendance session from their phone; students nearby scan for the beacon and mark themselves present — all verified server-side, hosted on Render, and stored in Neon PostgreSQL.

projects.title: StudySphere AI
projects.description: StudySphere AI is a full-stack AI-powered learning platform that integrates intelligent study tools into academic workflows. It enables AI-based note summarization, personalized quiz generation and editing, interactive 3D flashcards, an AI Tutor, and automated exam study planning. The platform also provides role-based workspaces for Students, Teachers, HODs, and Administrators, with a BYOK multi-provider AI architecture for flexible AI integration.

projects.title: Level-Up – AI-Powered Mock Test Platform
projects.description: An AI-powered mock test platform with Practice and Exam modes. Integrated AI-generated explanations and performance analysis for personalized learning. Designed responsive UI and secure backend for user management and test evaluation.

projects.title: Fake News Detection
projects.description: A machine learning-based web application to classify news as real or fake. Implemented data preprocessing and machine learning models, achieving high accuracy in classification.
